measurements.method: Real subprocess dispatches of runtime.py worker against a flocked append-only JSONL ledger; harvest is a post-join serial copy plus ledger harvest+complete records. Dispatch overhead is time.perf_counter_ns from Popen t0 to worker ready.

staggering_policy.follows_from: Analogue curve is spawn-bound through nproc; 429 threshold is NOT-CHECKED (hit_count=0); live inter-launch median_s=None; cloud leftover states the cloud fleet is terminated.
staggering_policy.policy: Local analogue: no 429 stagger; run at the spawn-bound knee (concurrency=8 on this 8-CPU box), which is the smallest measured doubling that still improves predicted 2048-unit wall-clock by at least 10 percent. Cursor-agent substrate: keep the live supervisor STAGGER=3.0s configured delay; do not raise arrival rate to hunt for an unobserved 429 cliff; a 429/529 is provider-side and is not a unit failure and must not reduce concurrency.
